tools.name: venue-atlas
tools.en: What a conference was about, year by year: 60,000 papers of seven venues on maps by meaning, named topics with their trends, search by meaning in the browser.
tools.zh: 一个会议这些年都在研究什么：七个会议的 6 万篇论文按内容画成地图，主题有名字、有逐年趋势，可以在浏览器里按语义搜索。
tools.command:
uvx --from git+https://github.com/zch6a/venue-atlas@v0 venue-atlas model    # the model, 30 MB, once
uvx --from git+https://github.com/zch6a/venue-atlas@v0 venue-atlas build iclr icml --out site

tools.name: paper-impact
tools.en: Which papers at AI venues mattered: every NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR and ACL paper with its citations and field-normalized impact from OpenAlex, and how much OpenAlex covers. A free OpenAlex key makes a full build days, not months.
tools.zh: AI 会议里哪些论文真正有影响：NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR、CVPR、ACL 的每篇论文，附 OpenAlex 的引用数和按领域归一化的影响力，并注明 OpenAlex 覆盖了多少。有免费的 OpenAlex key 时，完整构建只要几天而不是几个月。
tools.command:
curl -LO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zch6a/paper-impact/v0/venues.json
uvx --from git+https://github.com/zch6a/paper-impact@v0 paper-impact build venues.json -o site/ --years 2024

tools.name: table-trace
tools.en: Every number in a paper's tables, read from its LaTeX source and traced to its cell; and what papers report for the same model on the same benchmark, side by side.
tools.zh: 论文表格里的每个数字都从 LaTeX 源码读出、标明在哪个单元格；还能把各篇论文对同一模型在同一基准上报告的结果并排列出来。
tools.command: uvx --from git+https://github.com/zch6a/table-trace@v0 table-trace compare 1512.03385 2201.03545 --row ResNet-50 --col top-1 --col acc

tools.name: arxiv-diff
tools.en: What changed between two versions of a paper: the result numbers in its tables by row and column, and the text, abstract, authors, figures and references.
tools.zh: 论文两个版本之间改了什么：表格里按行列对应的结果数字，以及正文、摘要、作者、图和参考文献。

tools.name: gpu-budget
tools.en: How much GPU memory, time and money training, fine-tuning or serving an LLM takes, each part with its formula (ZeRO/FSDP, parallelism, MoE, LoRA/QLoRA, KV cache), checked against published runs.
tools.zh: 训练、微调或部署一个大模型要多少显存、时间和钱，每一项都给出公式（ZeRO/FSDP、各种并行、MoE、LoRA/QLoRA、KV 缓存），并和公开的训练记录对照过。

tools.name: exp-tables
tools.en: Experiment results to your paper's table: mean ± spread over seeds, significance against the best, bold only where the seeds support it; from CSV, wandb, TensorBoard or MLflow.
tools.zh: 把实验结果变成论文里的表：多个种子的均值 ± 标准差、与最好方法的显著性检验，只有多个种子的结果支持时才加粗；可读 CSV、wandb、TensorBoard、MLflow。

tools.name: repro-score
tools.en: Can someone reproduce your paper from your code? A score out of 100 for a research code repository, item by item with the file and line behind it, read from the files with nothing run.
tools.zh: 别人能不能用你的代码复现论文：给科研代码仓库打一个百分制的分，每一项都附上依据所在的文件和行号，只读文件、不运行任何代码。

tools.name: fig-check
tools.en: A paper's figures as they will print: text size at the printed scale, colours that collapse for colour-blind readers, raster resolution; for every figure of a LaTeX project.
tools.zh: 按论文印出来的样子检查每张图：印刷后的字号、色觉异常读者分不清的颜色、位图分辨率；覆盖 LaTeX 工程里的所有图。

tools.name: paper-proof
tools.en: Check your paper before reviewers do: invented or wrong references, bold results that are not the best, claimed gains that do not add up, stale abstract numbers, broken labels.
tools.zh: 赶在审稿人之前检查论文：编造或写错的参考文献、标粗却不是最好的结果、对不上的提升幅度、摘要里过时的数字、失效的交叉引用（\label/\ref）。

tools.name: submit-check
tools.en: Don't get desk-rejected for a slip: a LaTeX paper checked against the venue's rules (double-blind leaks, template mode, page limit, required sections, PDF fonts, leftover TODOs).
tools.zh: 别因为疏忽被直接拒稿：按会议规定检查 LaTeX 论文（双盲信息泄露、模板模式、页数、必需章节、PDF 字体、残留的 TODO）。

tools.name: iclr-scores
tools.en: What ICLR's review scores led to, 2017-2025: the acceptance rate by mean score, where half the papers got in, what disagreement did, and the odds for your scores.
tools.zh: ICLR 2017–2025 年的审稿分数最后换来了什么：各平均分的录用率、录用率过半的分数线、审稿人意见分歧的影响，以及你这组分数在往年的录用率。

tools.name: paper-page
tools.en: A project page for your paper from its arXiv id: links, teaser, abstract, BibTeX, Google Scholar and link-preview tags, in one static HTML file for GitHub Pages.
tools.zh: 用 arXiv 编号生成论文项目主页：链接、预览图、摘要、BibTeX、Google Scholar 标签与社交分享预览标签（Open Graph），一个静态 HTML 文件，直接放到 GitHub Pages。

tools.name: scholar-cards
tools.en: Your citations, h-index and most cited papers from OpenAlex as SVG cards for an academic homepage or a GitHub profile, kept fresh by a GitHub Action; no API key.
tools.zh: 把 OpenAlex 上你的引用数、h 指数和高被引论文做成 SVG 卡片，放进学术主页或 GitHub 个人页，由 GitHub Action 自动更新，不需要 API key。
